arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 -c "
base = open('/tmp/max96.json').read()
target = 8*1024*1024
pad = base[:-1] + ' ' * (target - len(base.encode()) - 2) + '}'
assert len(pad.encode()) == target, len(pad.encode())
open('/tmp/bigpad.json','w').write(pad)
open('/tmp/bigws.json','w').write(' ' * target)
open('/tmp/deep.json','w').write('[' * 200000 + ']' * 200000)
print('built')
" && for f in /tmp/bigpad.json /tmp/bigws.json /tmp/deep.json; do /tmp/timeit.sh $f /tmp/bigout.json; done
